cases.name: Amber Streitmatter
cases.about: Her obituary said Amber was a very spiritual person, who lived for the people she loved and always reminded them to have a strong faith and trust in Our Lord. The people who knew Amber would say that she was an exceptional woman. She will be dearly missed by her friends and family.
